house.description: Reduction to local government aid to a county or city that uses the incorrect state flag established.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes
Authors added Pérez-Vega, Virnig, Pursell, and Kozlowski

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; establishing a reduction to local government aid to a county or city that uses the incorrect state flag; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 477A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[477A.0177] AID REDUCTIONS FOR USE OF INCORRECT STATE FLAG. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Penalty.+]

[+Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the commissioner of revenue must reduce the aid to a county or city under sections 477A.011 to 477A.03 by ten percent if the county or city flies or otherwise makes use of a state flag other than the design of the state flag as certified in the report of the State Emblems Redesign Commission, as established by Laws 2023, chapter 62, article 2, section 118. The commissioner of revenue must reduce aid under this section for aid payable in the year following any year in which an instance occurred where the county or city used the incorrect state flag. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Notification.+]

[+On December 31 of each year, the governing body of any county or city subject to the penalty under subdivision 1 must notify the commissioner of revenue of the county's or city's use of the incorrect state flag. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective beginning with aids payable in 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; establishing a reduction to local government aid to a county or city that uses the incorrect state flag; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 477A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[477A.0177] AID REDUCTIONS FOR USE OF INCORRECT STATE FLAG.

Subdivision 1.

Penalty.

Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the commissioner of revenue must reduce the aid to a county or city under sections 477A.011 to 477A.03 by ten percent if the county or city flies or otherwise makes use of a state flag other than the design of the state flag as certified in the report of the State Emblems Redesign Commission, as established by Laws 2023, chapter 62, article 2, section 118. The commissioner of revenue must reduce aid under this section for aid payable in the year following any year in which an instance occurred where the county or city used the incorrect state flag.

Subd. 2.

Notification.

On December 31 of each year, the governing body of any county or city subject to the penalty under subdivision 1 must notify the commissioner of revenue of the county's or city's use of the incorrect state flag.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective beginning with aids payable in 2027.
additions: [477A.0177] AID REDUCTIONS FOR USE OF INCORRECT STATE FLAG.

Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the commissioner of revenue must reduce the aid to a county or city under sections 477A.011 to 477A.03 by ten percent if the county or city flies or otherwise makes use of a state flag other than the design of the state flag as certified in the report of the State Emblems Redesign Commission, as established by Laws 2023, chapter 62, article 2, section 118. The commissioner of revenue must reduce aid under this section for aid payable in the year following any year in which an instance occurred where the county or city used the incorrect state flag.

On December 31 of each year, the governing body of any county or city subject to the penalty under subdivision 1 must notify the commissioner of revenue of the county's or city's use of the incorrect state flag.
This section is effective beginning with aids payable in 2027.
